summary: Iteration 44 — Founder Freedom Directive Sprint #1 (Distribution-State Continuity) validated. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration44_founder_freedom_continuity.py (~28s incl. one real ffmpeg render, no YouTube publish executed). Verified: (a) ZERO-TOUCH PRODUCTION LINK — POST /api/factory-os/projects (video, forex trading basics) returns pid; POST /api/media-library/showcase/produce with human_approval_required + approved scenes + continuity_project_id=pid returns ok=true & continuity_updated=true; project auto-completes all pre-approval stages (knowledge_record, video_script, scene_matching, assembly, thumbnail_metadata, quality_review = complete), founder_approval = needs_approval, showcase_asset_id set, effort_minutes_saved>0 (=6). (b) GOLD MASTER HONESTY — on the freshly created zero-touch project the gold_master stage stays pending (never auto-completed by production). (c) AUTO-LINK ON PUBLISH — GET /api/youtube/distribution-records returns {records:[…], count:2}; MO-012 milestone record 2j-XfWY7wqE preserved with QA 100/100, channel 'Quest Understand', full field set (vault_asset_id, platform_video_id, publication_url, connected_channel, published_at, title_used, qa_results, checksum, source_licensing, responsible_approver, status='Published'), no _id leak; AWs0rflvT6o second record also present. (d) FAILURE ISOLATION guards — no-source→400 'factory asset or upload', missing→404 'not found', draft→400 'Draft previews cannot be published.'. (e) REGRESSION — /api/youtube/status connected=true account='Quest Understand', /api/youtube/factory-assets lists videos with no _id leak, /flagship-showcase /create /constitution all return 200 with correct headings. Frontend Playwright (1920×1080, Founder login → /projects): projects-effort banner (Founder Freedom Ledger) renders '0.5h absorbed · 6 automated actions · 1 auto-published' with 5 struck-through eliminated tasks; 12 project panels rendered; published project 0fd82cc8-… shows 11/11 complete stages, Next: 'Complete — the product has reached its intended human experience.', project-published-{id} section with youtube AWs0rflvT6o link + timestamp 7/11/2026, 1:07:14 AM; KR-gap projects render Knowledge Record blocked chip + Next 'Knowledge always comes before products — manufacture the Knowledge Record first in the Promotion Pipeline™.' + 'Manufacture the Knowledge Record' button. No failed_destinations exist so project-failed-{id} not currently visible (code path present, verified by code review). CRITICAL BUG FOUND (see rca): POST /api/factory-os/projects/{pid}/approve blindly completes ANY current needs_approval gate — including gold_master — WITHOUT calling certify_gold_master or checking Technical+Brand QA=100. Verified live: clicking Approve twice on a fresh zero-touch project moves gold_master from pending → needs_approval → complete with no QA gating. 4 legacy projects on the live DB already exhibit this exact honesty violation (gold_master=complete, no gold_master_certified action in history). This directly violates Constitution §10 and the Sprint #1 directive ('Publishing must NEVER falsely certify Gold Master').

critical.issue: approve_gate() in /app/backend/continuity.py auto-completes the current needs_approval gate WITHOUT distinguishing between founder_approval and gold_master. When founder_approval is complete and gold_master becomes needs_approval (via _advance_auto), clicking Approve again in the Projects UI silently marks gold_master='complete' — no Technical/Brand QA check, no on_gold_master call, no certification history entry. VIOLATES Constitution §10 + Founder Sprint #1 honesty invariant. Reproduced live: project 1355312e-3223-41b8-bce1-b9a63a624555 (fresh test project) went pending → needs_approval → complete after two Approve calls. 4 existing DB projects (0fd82cc8, 1e519b77, 010d4afc, 784bd0d7) already have gold_master=complete with NO gold_master_certified in history — same defect signature.

ui_bugs.issue: The Projects UI exposes an 'Approve & continue' button on every needs_approval gate. Because approve_gate treats gold_master identically to founder_approval, clicking this button on the gold_master gate falsely certifies Gold Master (no QA check, no certify-gold-master call). The UI should either (a) hide the approve button when cur.id === 'gold_master' and instead nav to the certify workflow (/flagship-showcase or asset-specific certify), or (b) display a distinct 'Certify Gold Master' button that calls /api/media-library/showcase/{asset_id}/certify-gold-master.

action_items: URGENT — Fix continuity.approve_gate() to refuse completing the gold_master gate. gold_master must ONLY complete via on_gold_master (called from POST /api/media-library/showcase/{asset_id}/certify-gold-master which enforces Technical+Brand QA=100). Suggested guard: `if cur.id == 'gold_master': raise/return {'ok': False, 'error': 'Gold Master requires certify-gold-master (Constitution §10). Approving here is not permitted.'}`.

URGENT — In ProjectsContinuity.js, when the current gate id is 'gold_master', do NOT render the generic project-approve-{id} button; render a dedicated 'Certify Gold Master' action that navigates to the certify endpoint for the showcase_asset_id.

Data remediation — 4 legacy continuity projects (0fd82cc8-9d2c-43b7-9bc5-13a26e87560e, 1e519b77-…, 010d4afc-…, 784bd0d7-…) currently have gold_master=complete without a gold_master_certified history entry. Decide whether to revert those to needs_approval or record a formal certification audit — otherwise the Distribution Acceptance Records for AWs0rflvT6o may inherit a false gold_master_certified=true value.

Consider hardening _write_distribution_record to explicitly reject writing gold_master_certified=true unless factory_doc.gold_master_certified is truly True at the moment of writing — currently it copies bool(factory_doc.get('gold_master_certified')) which is correct, but the concern is upstream mutation.
critical_code_review_comments: continuity.py::approve_gate — treats every needs_approval gate identically (`cur['status'] = 'complete'`). No branch on stage id. This is the root cause of the gold_master honesty violation. The function needs an explicit `if cur['id'] == 'gold_master'` refusal path with a clear error and route hint (/flagship-showcase → certify).

continuity.py::on_published (correct) — properly skips gold_master via `if s['id'] == 'gold_master': continue`. This path is honest; the leak comes from approve_gate, not from publish. Recommend adding a unit-level docstring assertion to prevent regression.

ProjectsContinuity.js:106-108 — the project-approve-{id} button is rendered whenever `cur?.status === 'needs_approval'`. It should discriminate on `cur?.id === 'gold_master'` and route to certify rather than call /approve.

media_library.py::certify_gold_master — swallows on_gold_master exceptions silently (`except Exception: pass`). If on_gold_master ever fails, the certificate succeeds at the media-asset level but the project chain is left unlinked. Log the exception (at least at WARN) so this stays observable.

continuity.py::on_publish_failed — records the failed destination correctly but never sets any chain stage to 'blocked'. The UI still shows the previous stage state, which could confuse the operator. Consider setting the publishing stage to 'blocked' (with a retry route) when the current publishing/distribution stage is not yet complete.

rca of the issue: Root cause: /app/backend/continuity.py:approve_gate lines 237-249 finds the first stage with status=='needs_approval' and unconditionally sets it to 'complete', regardless of the stage's identity. When the Product Continuity chain sequences founder_approval → gold_master (both kind='gate'), the standard flow is: production_complete auto-advances to founder_approval=needs_approval → operator approves via /projects/{pid}/approve → founder_approval=complete + _advance_auto → gold_master=needs_approval → operator (accidentally or maliciously) clicks Approve again → gold_master=complete. This bypasses certify_gold_master() which enforces Technical QA=100 AND Brand/Content QA=100 (Constitution §10). Reproduction: POST /api/factory-os/projects {outcome_id:'video', topic:'…'} → POST /api/media-library/showcase/produce (with continuity_project_id) → POST /api/factory-os/projects/{pid}/approve → POST /api/factory-os/projects/{pid}/approve again. Verified: gold_master went pending → needs_approval → complete on project 1355312e-3223-41b8-bce1-b9a63a624555 (history shows two 'approved' actions for stages founder_approval + gold_master, no 'gold_master_certified'). Mitigation: 1) In continuity.approve_gate, add `if cur['id'] == 'gold_master': return {**p, 'summary': _summary(p), 'error': 'Gold Master requires certify-gold-master. Approving here is not permitted.'}` (or raise HTTP 400 at the router). 2) In ProjectsContinuity.js, hide/replace project-approve-{id} when cur.id==='gold_master' — swap for a dedicated 'Certify Gold Master' button that navigates to the certify flow. 3) Consider adding the same guard for any future certification-only gates by tagging them (e.g., `certify_only:true` in CHAINS).
